id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Multi-drop single-wire bus; one master + many slaves on a shared open-drain DQ line, addressed by 64-bit ROM ID. Network can be physically organized as Linear, Stubbed, Star, or Switched.

supported_topologies.name: Linear
supported_topologies.description: Single twisted pair starts at master and extends to farthest slave; intermediate slaves attach with stubs < 3 m. PREFERRED for long networks.

supported_topologies.name: Stubbed
supported_topologies.description: Main backbone from master with branches/stubs ≥ 3 m to slaves. Acceptable for medium networks; performance degrades with stub length and count.

supported_topologies.name: Star
supported_topologies.description: Multiple branches diverging at master; not recommended due to impedance mismatch and reflections from each branch's end.

supported_topologies.name: Switched
supported_topologies.description: Star or stubbed network using DS2409 1-Wire switches to electrically isolate inactive branches — each active branch electrically behaves as a linear network.

fields.topology_intermixing_rule: When different topologies are intermixed in a single network, the designer should defer to the most conservative limit. Example: a switched star with three 50-m linear branches has effective radius 150 m and effective weight 150 m (only one branch at a time, not 450 m total).

master_slave_role_summary.description: The single bus-master; drives all time slots, the Reset Pulse, ROM commands, ROM-ID transmission, function commands, and Write slots. Samples Presence Pulse and Read slots.
Wakes on Reset Pulse, drives Presence Pulse, listens for ROM commands, drops out on Match/Search ROM mismatch, responds to function commands when addressed. Cannot initiate traffic.
Powered solely from DQ HIGH periods via on-chip storage capacitor. Vulnerable to brown-out during long Write-0 sequences.
Powered from a separate VDD pin in addition to DQ; immune to parasite-power starvation.
Special slave that gates DQ to downstream branches — enables Switched topology.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no protocol-layer interconnect (no router / bridge). The bus is a flat shared wire; multi-drop addressing is via 64-bit ROM ID transmitted on DQ.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_byte: Bits transmitted LSB-first; receiver reassembles MSB on the master side.
ordering_guarantees.within_rom_id: Family code → Serial number → CRC-8 (each field LSB-first within its bytes).
ordering_guarantees.global_ordering: Single shared bus; bits arrive in transmission order; collisions during Search ROM are resolved by the binary-tree algorithm.

physical_layer_parameters.cable_typical: Category 5 twisted pair (5 V bus from master)
physical_layer_parameters.capacitance_per_meter: ~24 pF/m equivalent (rough rule of thumb for slave weight)

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Not applicable — 1-Wire is a multi-drop wire protocol; per-slave register / memory maps are device-specific and accessed AFTER address resolution.

device_classification.DS18B20: Digital temperature sensor; family code 0x28; common 1-Wire slave.
device_classification.DS2401 / DS2411: Silicon serial number (ROM ID only, no function); family code 0x01.
device_classification.DS2438: Smart battery monitor; voltage/current/temperature; family code 0x26.
device_classification.DS2480B: Serial-to-1-Wire converter (master-end IC); used in DS9097U PC adapter.
device_classification.iButton: Steel-can 1-Wire token (DS1990, DS1971, DS1996 etc.); family-code per part.
